name: VL53L1X
description: Pololu's VL53L1X library (ST VL53L1X time-of-flight distance sensor) where the I2C bus and the clock can be given by the caller (setPlatform(): write / read / millis / delay_us callbacks): no Arduino needed (VL53L1X_NO_ARDUINO). With Arduino and nothing given it is Pololu's library as it was: Wire, millis(), delay().
